notes: The 12/12tick exploratory limit leaves effectively no timing margin at2MHz.
The 9/9tick experiment does not change production defaults and does not qualify external drive pulse widths.
Four mutation controls on separately compiled copies detect stuck counts, missing fault flags, short pulse widths and silent channel11.

Initial mutation r01 expected a later assertion; the earlier correct pulse-mismatch assertion fired. r02 isolates the timing-boundary case and passes all specified assertions. No production code was changed.
DATASHEET LIMIT entries require exact manufacturer revision/table/conditions; no generic component maximum is substituted for this unfinished board.
